name: Nikon Z 9
description: Nikon Z 9，尼康FX全画幅Z卡口无反相机。参数来自尼康官方规格及说明书，保留最高性能的适用条件。

rows.label: 相机类型
rows.value: 可更换镜头数码相机

rows.label: 镜头卡口
rows.value: 尼康Z卡口

rows.label: 兼容镜头
rows.value: 尼克尔Z卡口镜头；尼克尔F卡口镜头需使用卡口适配器，可能存在功能限制
rows.originalValue: Z mount NIKKOR lenses F mount NIKKOR lenses (mount adapter required; restrictions may apply)

rows.label: 有效像素
rows.value: 45.7百万像素

rows.label: 类型
rows.value: 35.9 x 23.9 mm CMOS传感器 (尼康FX格式)

rows.label: 总像素
rows.value: 52.37百万像素

rows.label: 除尘系统
rows.value: 图像传感器清洁, 图像除尘参考数据 (需要 NX Studio)
rows.originalValue: Image sensor cleaning, Image Dust Off reference data (requires NX Studio)

rows.label: 文件格式
rows.value: NEF (RAW): 14位 可选无损压缩、高效率★或高效率 JPEG: 兼容JPEG Baseline，精细 (约 1:4), 标准 (约 1:8), 或基本 (约 1:16) 压缩；可选文件大小优先或最佳画质优先 NEF (RAW)+JPEG: 同一照片同时记录NEF（RAW）和JPEG
rows.originalValue: NEF (RAW): 14 bit with lossless compression, high efficiency★, and high efficiency options JPEG: JPEG-Baseline compliant with fine (约 1:4), normal (约 1:8), or basic (约 1:16) compression; size-priority and optimal-quality compression available NEF (RAW)+JPEG: Single photograph recorded in both NEF (RAW) and JPEG formats

rows.label: 优化校准
rows.value: 自动, 标准, 自然, 鲜艳, 单色, 人像, 风景, 平面, 20 创意优化校准; 可修改所选优化校准，并保存自定义优化校准
rows.originalValue: Auto, Standard, Neutral, Vivid, Monochrome, Portrait, Landscape, Flat, 20 Creative Picture Controls; selected Picture Control can be modified; storage for custom Picture Controls

rows.label: 存储介质
rows.value: CFexpress (B型), XQD 存储卡
rows.originalValue: CFexpress (Type B), XQD memory cards

rows.label: 双卡槽
rows.value: 卡槽2可用于顺序记录、备份、NEF（RAW）与JPEG分卡记录，或保存不同尺寸与画质的JPEG副本；支持卡间复制照片
rows.originalValue: The card in Slot 2 can be used for overflow or backup storage, for separate storage of NEF (RAW) and JPEG pictures, or for storage of duplicate JPEG pictures at different sizes and image qualities; pictures can be copied between cards

rows.label: 测光模式
rows.value: 矩阵、中央重点或亮部重点测光
rows.originalValue: Matrix, center-weighted or highlight-weighted

rows.label: 视频文件格式
rows.value: NEV, MOV, MP4

rows.label: 视频编码
rows.value: N-RAW (12位), Apple ProRes RAW HQ (12位), Apple ProRes 422 HQ (10位), H.265/HEVC (8/10位), H.264/AVC (8位)
rows.originalValue: N-RAW (12 bit), Apple ProRes RAW HQ (12 bit), Apple ProRes 422 HQ (10 bit), H.265/HEVC (8/10 bit), H.264/AVC (8 bit)

rows.label: 录音格式
rows.value: 线性PCM (适用于以下格式的视频： NEV或MOV) 或 AAC (适用于以下格式的视频： MP4)
rows.originalValue: Linear PCM (for videos recorded in NEV or MOV format) or AAC (for videos recorded in MP4)

rows.label: 录音装置
rows.value: 内置立体声或外接麦克风，可选衰减器并调整灵敏度
rows.originalValue: Built-in stereo or external microphone with attenuator option; sensitivity adjustable

rows.label: 曝光补偿
rows.value: -3 至 +3 EV 步进为 1/3 或 1/2 EV
rows.originalValue: -3 to +3 EV in steps of 1/3 or 1/2 EV

rows.label: 感光度（推荐曝光指数）
rows.value: M模式： 手动选择 (ISO 64 至 25600 步进为 1/6, 1/3 或 1 EV); 还可扩展至相当于 约 0.3, 0.7, 1 或 2 EV (ISO 102400 等效) 高于ISO 25600; 自动ISO感光度控制 (ISO 64 至 Hi 2.0) 可用且可设置上限 P、S或A模式： 自动 ISO感光度控制 (ISO 64 至 Hi 2.0) 可设置上限
rows.originalValue: M mode: Manual selection (ISO 64 to 25600 in steps of 1/6, 1/3 or 1 EV); with additional options available equivalent to 约 0.3, 0.7, 1 or 2 EV (ISO 102400 equivalent) above ISO 25600; auto ISO sensitivity control (ISO 64 to Hi 2.0) available with selectable upper limit P, S or A mode: Auto ISO sensitivity control (ISO 64 to Hi 2.0) with selectable upper limit

rows.label: 其他功能
rows.value: 延时视频录制, 电子减震, 时间码, N-Log 、 HDR (HLG) video, 波形显示, 红色录制边框指示, 视频录制显示缩放 (50%, 100%、 200%), 扩展快门速度 (M模式)、 RAW视频双格式（代理视频）记录; 支持扩展超采样; 可通过i菜单查看视频录制信息; 高分辨率变焦
rows.originalValue: Time-lapse movie recording, electronic vibration reduction, time codes, N-Log and HDR (HLG) video, wave-form display, red REC frame indicator, video recording display zoom (50%, 100%, and 200%), extended shutter speeds (mode M), and dual-format (proxy-video) recording for RAW video; extended oversampling available; option to view video recording info available via i menu; Hi-Res Zoom

rows.label: 取景器
rows.value: 1.27-cm/0.5-in. 约 3690k-dot (Quad VGA) OLED 电子取景器 支持色彩平衡、自动亮度及 18级手动亮度调节; 支持高刷新率显示
rows.originalValue: 1.27-cm/0.5-in. 约 3690k-dot (Quad VGA) OLED electronic viewfinder with color balance and auto and 18-level manual brightness controls; high frame-rate display available

rows.label: 视野率
rows.value: 约 100% 水平及垂直均为100%
rows.originalValue: 约 100% horizontal and 100% vertical

rows.originalValue: 约 0.8x (50 mm lens at infinity, -1.0 m -1 )

rows.originalValue: 8-cm/3.2-in., 约 2100k-dot vertically and horizontally tilting TFT touch-sensitive LCD with 170° viewing angle, 约 100% frame coverage, and color balance and 15-level manual brightness controls

rows.label: 类型
rows.value: 电子快门 带快门音及传感器保护罩
rows.originalValue: Electronic shutter with shutter sound and sensor shield

rows.value: 1/32000 至 30 s 步进为 1/3, 1/2 、 1 EV, 可扩展至 900 s 在M模式下, B门、T门
rows.originalValue: 1/32000 to 30 s in steps of 1/3, 1/2 and 1 EV, extendable to 900 s in mode M, bulb, time

rows.value: 单张、低速连拍、高速连拍、高速画面捕捉+（支持预拍摄）、自拍
rows.originalValue: Single frame, continuous L, continuous H, High-Speed Frame Capture+ (with Pre-Release Capture), self-timer

rows.value: 低速连拍: 约 1 至 10 fps 高速连拍: 约 10 至 20 fps 高速画面捕捉+ (C30): 约 30 fps 高速画面捕捉+ (C60): 约 60 fps 高速画面捕捉+ (C120): 约 120 fps
rows.condition: 高速抓拍仅记录JPEG；C60使用DX裁切及大尺寸，C120使用FX及小尺寸（约1100万像素）。C30为FX或DX、大尺寸。Z8较新固件可选择JPEG 精细/标准；Z9此说明书版本限JPEG 标准。最高速度依设定与存储卡而变。
rows.originalValue: Continuous L: 约 1 to 10 fps Continuous H: 约 10 to 20 fps High-Speed Frame Capture+ (C30): 约 30 fps High-Speed Frame Capture+ (C60): 约 60 fps High-Speed Frame Capture+ (C120): 约 120 fps

rows.label: 高速抓拍画质与尺寸限制
rows.value: C30：FX/DX、大尺寸；C60：DX、大尺寸；C120：FX、小尺寸。仅JPEG；C120使用DX镜头时改为C60。
